subject: Activation Clustering kickoff - interpretability for the debugging offering
body:
Team,

Kicking off the Activation Clustering evaluation. Context: our model-debugging engagements keep hitting the same wall - customers can see *that* a model fails, not *why*. The activation clustering method from our open-source release (unsupervised clustering over a trained model's activations, per the "Explaining Deep Neural Networks using Unsupervised Clustering" work) gives us cluster-level concepts and similar-image retrieval from any baseline model, which is exactly the missing artifact in those engagements.

The repo is nicely self-contained: docker build, jupyter server in the container, worked CIFAR-10 examples for training an activation clustering model from a baseline and visualizing similar images and concepts.

Window plan: repro + internal-model spike by March 20; utility assessment on two real debugging cases by April 17; productization decision April 30, with the actual productization sprint (if green) planned for June.

Bao - staffing please, including who carries the June sprint if we go.

Anders
